router_id.description: global_defs router_id — a name for this node in notifications (unset: the hostname).

vrrp_instances.description: VRRP instances: name, interface, virtual_router_id (1–255, the same on every node of the group), priority (higher wins), state (MASTER/BACKUP), advert_int, optional auth_pass, and virtual_ipaddresses (address/prefix). A site value: keepalived has nothing to run without one ("keepalived has no configuration to run") and never reports ready.
